## Technical Background & Capabilities
Naitik Grover has over 4+ years of professional experience building scalable web applications and AI-driven solutions.
- **Frontend Development**: React.js, Next.js, TypeScript, JavaScript (ES6+), HTML5, CSS3, Tailwind CSS, Framer Motion, GSAP animations, 3D WebGL via Three.js.
- **Backend & Cloud**: Node.js, Express.js, MongoDB, RESTful APIs, WebSockets, Deployment & Infrastructure.
- **Product Architecture**: Building end-to-end SAAS, AI content platforms, corporate agency applications, e-commerce templates, and custom Web applications.

## Key Projects Portfolio
1. **Verseo** (https://adyber-p1.framer.website/): AI Content Platform. Built with Framer, React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS.
2. **Adyber** (https://www.adyber.com/): Official agency website. Built with Next.js, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Framer Motion.
3. **Angel's World School** (https://www.angelworldschool.com/): Educational web application. Built with WordPress, PHP, Custom CSS, and SEO optimization.
4. **Ristorante** (https://ristorante.framer.website/): Restaurant reservation & menu web app. Built with Framer, React, Motion.

6. **Ecom** (https://ecom-template.framer.ai/): E-commerce storefront template. Built with Framer, React, TypeScript.
